blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Material generation should produce not only an appearance, but also the rules that construct it.
We introduce MatLoom , a compact, layer-oriented language for text-to-material generation with pretrained language models.
Each program composes alpha-masked layers whose shared spatial expressions define coverage and physically based rendering (PBR) channels, making dependencies between patterns, color, and relief explicit.
A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps, while the source retains named fields and layer parameters for subsequent authoring.
Without task-specific fine-tuning, our pipeline uses parser-guided repair and preview-based critique to revise material designs, then searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate’s remaining source fixed.
On a curated benchmark of 141 141 prompts evaluated with six backbones, our best-performing configuration achieves higher mean scores than three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout prompt-alignment metrics.
Its initial programs already exceed all three baselines on mean BLIPScore, before critique or seed search.
Retained programs have a median length of 21 21 lines when pooled across backbones.
In a blind four-way comparison involving 30 30 participants and 20 20 prompts, our renders receive 59.2 % 59.2\% of choices, compared with 19.3 % 19.3\% for the most-preferred baseline.
Compact executable programs thus offer a way to generate prompt-aligned materials while retaining their construction as part of the asset.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Material authoring rarely ends with the first render.
A designer may ask to widen the grout between tiles, roughen a coating, or change a glaze color while preserving the rest of the surface (Figure 5 ).
Text-to-material diffusion methods generate detailed physically based rendering (PBR) maps ( Vecchio et al., 2024 ; Vecchio, 2026 ; Kocsis et al., 2025 ) , but their raster outputs do not expose the construction rules behind spatial layout, relief, and reflectance.
Procedural programs and graphs keep those rules as operations and parameters ( Guerrero et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , making the generated asset easier to inspect, re-evaluate, and revise.
blocks.zh:
材料的作者很少以第一次渲染结束。
设计者可能要求拓宽瓷砖之间的凹槽,使涂料粗糙,或者在保留其余表面的同时改变玻璃颜色(图5 )。
文本对材料传播方法生成详细的物理渲染(PBR)地图(Vecchio等人,2024年;Vecchio,2026年;Kocsis等人,2025年),但其光栅输出不会暴露空间布局,解脱,反射背后的构造规则.
程序程序和图表将这些规则作为业务和参数(Guerrero等人,2022年;Li等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年),使生成的资产更容易检查、重新评估和修订。

blocks.en:
Can compact material programs serve as an effective output space for pretrained language models, combining text-to-material fidelity with explicit authoring structure? This question follows a broader line of work on programs as visual representations ( Sharma et al., 2018 ; Jones et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) .
For materials, the representation must express coupled decisions: a tile lattice defines both coverage and height, a crack has shape and relief, and a coating changes reflectance only where it is applied.
Existing material languages and systems expose different parts of this structure.
MDL supports declarative material definitions and layering ( Kettner et al., 2015 ; NVIDIA, 2014 ) ; MultiMat serializes Substance graphs in a compact DSL with validation and visual feedback ( Belouadi et al., 2026 ) ; and Material Apprentice synthesizes procedural materials from text by retrieving expert process traces ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) .
We study a more restricted point in this design space: a layer-oriented field language between a natural-language request and rendered material maps.
blocks.zh:
紧凑的材料程序能否成为预先训练的语言模型的有效输出空间,将文本至材料的忠实与明确的写作结构结合起来? 这个问题遵循关于视觉表现等节目的更广泛工作方针(Sharma等人,2018年;Jones等人,2020年;Zhang等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年)。
对于材料而言,表示必须表达共同的决定:一个瓦片层既定义了覆盖度,也界定了高度,裂缝有形状和解脱度,涂层变化只有在应用时才会反射.
现有的材料语言和系统暴露了这种结构的不同部分.
MDL支持声明材料定义和分层(Kettner等人,2015年;NVIDIA,2014年);MultiMat序列化. 具有验证和视觉反馈的紧凑DSL中的物质图(Belouadi等人,2026年);以及材料学徒通过检索专家过程痕迹从文本中合成程序材料(Gupta等人,2026年)。
我们研究了这个设计空间中一个更受限制的点:在自然语言请求和制作材料地图之间,一个面向一层的场面语言.

blocks.en:
We introduce MatLoom , a compact language that represents a material as a stack of alpha-masked layers (Figure 1 ).
Each layer assigns PBR channels through expressions over a two-dimensional domain, and named spatial fields can be shared across masks, color, roughness, and height.
This design exposes three authoring decisions to the model: which spatial patterns to define, how layers use those patterns, and which stochastic realization of the noise fields to render.
A standalone interpreter evaluates the program into material maps at a chosen raster resolution, with pinned noise seeds for repeatable execution within a fixed implementation.
The restricted vocabulary trades the breadth of a general graph or shader language for concise programs whose dependencies remain visible in source.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍 MatLoom,一种紧凑的语言,它代表着一个材料,作为堆积的α层(图1).
每层通过二维域上的表达式分配PBR通道,命名的空间域可以跨越口罩,颜色,粗糙度和高度共享.
这种设计使三个作者决定暴露在模型上:要定义的空间模式,层层如何使用这些模式,以及要渲染的噪声场的分层实现.
一个独立的解译器在选择的光栅分辨率下将程序评价成材料地图,并带有固定执行范围内可重复执行的固定噪声种子.
限制的词汇交换一般图形或阴影语言的宽度,用于简明程序,其依赖性在源代码中仍然可见.

blocks.en:
Our synthesis procedure uses that separation to organize inference.
A pretrained language model writes and repairs a program using parser feedback.
A critic then inspects a fast preview, channel statistics, and source code where configured, and revises the material design.
Finally, a text–image scorer selects candidates from the revision trajectory and searches noise seeds while keeping each candidate’s other expressions fixed.
The same explicit program is therefore the object of generation, repair, critique, selection, seed exploration, and later rendering.
blocks.zh:
我们的合成程序利用这种分离来组织推论。
一个预先训练的语言模型使用解析器反馈来写和修复一个程序.
评论家然后检查一个快速预览,频道统计,以及配置的源代码,并修改材料设计.
最后,一个文本-图像计分员从修订轨迹中挑选候选人,并搜索噪音种子,同时固定每个候选人的其他表达方式。
因此,同样的明确程序是生成、修理、批评、选择、种子探索和后来渲染的对象。

blocks.en:
We evaluate MatLoom on a curated benchmark of 141 141 prompts with six language-model backbones and three diffusion baselines.
Across retained programs from all backbones, the median length is 21 21 lines.
The best configuration exceeds the baselines in mean score on all four flat-layout alignment metrics, and its initial programs already exceed all baselines on mean BLIPScore before critique or seed search.
In a blind four-way study with 30 30 participants and 20 20 prompts, MatLoom receives 59.2 % 59.2\% of choices, compared with 19.3 % 19.3\% for the most-preferred baseline.
These results show that compact executable programs can be competitive for prompt-aligned material generation while preserving construction as part of the asset.
They do not yet establish a causal advantage over every procedural representation; matched comparisons against alternatives such as direct Blender, MDL, and released procedural systems remain important follow-up tests.
blocks.zh:
我们以141 141个速率为基准来评价MatLoom,并有6个语言模型主干线和3个传播基线。
在所有主干部分保留的程序中,中间长度为21 21行。
最佳配置超过所有四个平铺对齐度量的平均分数的基线,其初始程序在批评或种子搜索之前已经超过平均BLIPScore的所有基线。
在一项有30人和20人参与的盲目四行研究中,MatLoom获得59.2%的选题,而最受欢迎的基线为19.3%。
这些结果表明,紧凑的可执行程序可以具有竞争力,能够迅速对齐材料生成,同时保留建筑作为资产的一部分.
它们尚未确定每一程序代表的因果关系;与直接Blender、MDL等替代物进行比较,以及公布的程序系统仍然是重要的后续测试。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A layered authoring representation. Shared spatial expressions connect coverage and PBR channels through explicit compositing rules, retaining compact source for inspection, parameter edits, and procedural resampling (Section 3 ). • A synthesis procedure that separates design from realization. Parser-guided repair and preview-based critique revise programs, while seed search explores stochastic variants of fixed candidate designs without task-specific fine-tuning (Section 4 ). • An empirical analysis across backbones and inference stages. A 141 141 -prompt benchmark and a blind preference study show strong prompt alignment against diffusion baselines while exposing backbone dependence and metric disagreement (Section 5 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Inverse rendering estimates spatially varying reflectance from photographs ( Deschaintre et al., 2018 ; Deschaintre et al., 2019 ; Guo et al., 2020 ; Lopes et al., 2024 ) , and text-conditioned systems synthesize PBR maps from language or other visual inputs ( He et al., 2023 ; Vecchio et al., 2024 ; Vecchio, 2026 ; Kocsis et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2026 ) .
These raster maps support rendering, relighting, and some map-level editing. MatLoom instead retains an executable source program, so the construction of the maps can be inspected, re-evaluated, and resampled.
Our diffusion comparisons therefore test rendered appearance against strong raster baselines, not superiority over procedural generators.
blocks.zh:
反渲染从照片(Deschaintre等人,2018年;Deschaintre等人,2019年;Guo等人,2020年;Lopes等人,2024年)和文字条件化系统从语言或其他视觉输入中合成PBR地图(He等人,2023年;Vecchio等人,2024年;Vecchio,2026年;Kocsis等人,2025年;Luo等人,2026年)。
这些光栅图支持渲染,重燃,以及一些地图级别的编辑. MatLoom转而保留一个可执行源程序,因此可以检查,重新评价地图的构造,并重印.
因此,我们的传播比较使光栅基线显示,而不是优于程序发电机。

blocks.en:
MATch optimizes existing procedural graphs ( Shi et al., 2020 ) , MatFormer and conditional MatFormer generate graph structure and parameters ( Guerrero et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ) , and ProcMatRL improves image-conditioned parameter prediction ( Li et al., 2024 ) .
VLMaterial generates Blender Python programs from images with a fine-tuned vision-language model ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
MultiMat introduces CompactSBS, a compact YAML representation of Substance graphs with visual feedback, validation, and repair, evaluated on image-conditioned and unconditional tasks ( Belouadi et al., 2026 ) .
MatLayerNet plans layered aging materials with LLM agents and a curated mask library ( Cai et al., 2026 ) .
Material Apprentice is closest in task definition because it supports text-to-procedural generation and editing by retrieving expert process traces and compiling them into Blender graphs ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) . MatLoom focuses on a different representation choice: a restricted field vocabulary with ordered alpha-composited layers, standalone execution, explicit layer parameters, and text-conditioned synthesis by pretrained language models.
Direct matched-budget comparisons to Material Apprentice, Blender Python, MDL, and other procedural representations remain future work.
blocks.zh:
MATch优化了现有的程序图(Shi等人,2020年),MatFormer和有条件的MatFormer生成图结构和参数(Guerrero等人,2022年;Hu等人,2023年),ProcMatRL改进了图像条件参数预测(Li等人,2024年).
VLMaterial 生成 Blender Python程序来自带有微调视觉语言模型的图像(Li等人,2025年).
多Met 介绍 ContractingSBS,一种带有视觉反馈、验证和修复的物质图的简约YAML表示,根据图像条件和无条件的任务进行评估(Belouadi等人,2026年)。
MatLayerNet计划用LLM代理和一个配有装饰的面具库对老化材料进行分层(Cai等人,2026年).
材料学徒最接近任务定义,因为它支持文本到程序生成和编辑,方法是检索专家过程的痕迹并将其汇编成Blender图表(Gupta等人,2026年). MatLoom专注于不同的表达选择:一个限制字段词汇,有命令的alpha-composited 层,独立执行,明确的层参数,以及通过预先训练的语言模型进行文本条件合成.
与材料学徒、Blender Python、MDL和其他程序性陈述的直接对应预算比较仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Graphics-program inference ( Ellis et al., 2018 ) , ShapeAssembly ( Jones et al., 2020 ) , and Scene Language ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) connect learned generation to editable visual structure.
LAPS and LILO show how language can guide reusable program abstractions ( Wong et al., 2021 ; Grand et al., 2024 ) , while grammar prompting provides structured constraints for DSL generation ( Wang et al., 2023 ) .
Program repair ( Xia et al., 2023 ) , iterative critique ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) , and rendered feedback ( Wu et al., 2025 ) are established components.
MDL separates declarative material definitions, including layering, from rendering algorithms ( Kettner et al., 2015 ) ; MaterialX supports portable material graphs ( Academy Software Foundation, 2026 ) ; and OpenPBR specifies a surface shading model ( Portsmouth et al., 2025 ) . MatLoom combines program repair, rendered critique, and execution feedback inside a deliberately smaller material vocabulary.
The goal is to measure the costs and benefits of that vocabulary, rather than to claim invention of portable material languages.
Table 3 summarizes the task and representation boundaries.

LAPS和LILO显示语言如何指导可重复使用的程序抽象(Wong等人,2021年;Grand等人,2024年),而语法提示为DSL生成提供了结构化的限制(Wang等人,2023年).
程序修复 (Xia等人,2023年),迭代批判(Madaan等人,2023年;Gou等人,2024年),提供反馈(Wu等人,2025年)是既定的组成部分.
MDL从渲染算法(Kettner等人,2015年)中分离出宣示性材料定义,包括分层;MDL支持便携式材料图表(Academy Software Foundation,2026年);OpenPBR指定了表面阴影模型(Portsmouth等人,2025年). MatLoom将程序修复、批评和执行反馈结合起来,
目标是衡量这些词汇的成本和效益,而不是声称发明了便携式材料语言。

blocks.en: 3 The MatLoom Representation
blocks.zh: 3. 马特卢姆代表处

blocks.en:
The representation separates editable source from sampled material maps (Figure 2 ).
A program defines spatial fields, assigns them to layer coverage and PBR channels, and evaluates them at a chosen resolution.
Layers group coverage with surface properties, named fields expose cross-channel dependencies, and explicit seeds distinguish a design from one stochastic realization.
blocks.zh:
该表述将可编辑来源与抽样材料地图(图2)分开。
一个程序定义了空间域,将其分配到层覆盖和PBR通道,并在一个选定的解析度对其进行评价.
具有表层特性的层层群覆盖,命名的字段暴露了跨通道的依赖性,明确的种子将一个设计与一个分层实现区分开来.

blocks.en:
A material concept such as grout or glaze can affect several properties in one region.
Layers keep those properties together, while a shared field lets one motif drive multiple channels.
These are inspectable source dependencies, although their effect on generation or editing success still needs matched controls.
blocks.zh:
一个物质概念,如grout或glaze,可以影响一个区域的几个属性.
层使这些属性保持在一起,而一个共享的字段则允许一个驱动多个通道的motif.
这些是可检查的来源依赖性,尽管它们对生成或编辑成功的影响仍然需要相应的控制。

blocks.en: Changing explicit seeds explores realizations of a fixed program, but seeded noise can affect coverage, color, and height as well as fine texture.
blocks.zh: 改变显性种子探索固定程序的实现,但种子噪声会影响覆盖,颜色,高度以及精细的纹理.

blocks.en: 3.1 Program Structure
blocks.zh: 3.1 方案结构

blocks.en:
A program has an optional sampling window ( View ), named expressions ( Define ), and bottom-to-top layers ( Material ).
Expressions are fields over the X ​ Y XY plane, with + x +x right and + y +y up.
Changing raster size re-samples the same source fields, although normals, approximate ambient occlusion, and exported pixels depend on resolution.
Listing 1 gives a complete two-layer tile program.
blocks.zh:
一个程序有一个可选的采样窗口(view ),命名表达式(Definition ),以及从下到上层(material ).
表达式是XY XY平面上方的字段,右侧为+x +x,上方为+y +y.
变化的光栅大小重新对相同的源字段进行采样,虽然正常,大概的环境封存,和导出像素取决于分辨率.
Listing 1给出了一个完整的两层瓦片程序.

blocks.en:
Each layer assigns coverage α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] , base color, roughness, metallicity, emission, other surface-response channels, and height h h .
Values can be constants or expressions built from transforms, noise, periodic patterns, and shapes.
Named definitions form an acyclic graph and can be reused, as when the tile mask drives both coverage and height.
Exported channels map to renderer inputs ( Burley, 2012 ; Portsmouth et al., 2025 ) ; this is an authoring convention rather than a physically derived coating model.
Channel ranges and validation are specified in Appendix Q.2 .
blocks.zh:
每层的覆盖度为α[0, 1]\alpha\in [0, 1], 底色, 粗糙度, 金属度, 排放量, 其他表面反应通道, 高度 h 。
值可以是由变形,噪声,周期规律,和形状所形成的常数或表达式.
命名的定义形成一个循环图,可以重复使用,就像瓦片面具驱动覆盖和高度一样.
输出通道映射到渲染器输入(Burley,2012年;Portsmouth等人,2025年);这是一个写作公约,而不是物理衍生的涂层模型.
通道范围和验证在附录Q.2中规定.

blocks.en: 3.2 Compositing Semantics

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
Our evaluation asks two questions: whether the complete authoring system produces renders that match material descriptions, and whether its recorded programs expose useful post-generation control.
We therefore separate prompt-alignment results from evidence about the representation itself.
The benchmark, trajectory analysis, and blind study measure rendered appearance; a manual edit case illustrates program-level control for one material.
All means average the three recorded runs for each prompt and then average over 141 141 prompts, unless stated otherwise.
blocks.zh:
我们的评价提出了两个问题:完全的作者系统是否使这种材料描述吻合,以及其记录的程序是否暴露出有用的生成后控制.
因此,我们把迅速调整与代表本身的证据分开。
基准、轨迹分析和盲目研究度量使得出现;一个人工编辑案例说明了一种材料的程序级别控制。
除非另有说明,所有这一切都意味着记录的3个急速运行,然后平均超过141 141个急速运行。

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
The benchmark contains 141 141 prompts from four public sources: category prompts from Hu et al. (2023) ( 30 30 ), MatSynth descriptions ( Vecchio & Deschaintre, 2024 ) ( 11 11 ), StableMaterials prompts ( Vecchio, 2026 ) ( 50 50 ), and text2fabric descriptions ( Deschaintre et al., 2023 ) ( 50 50 ).
Sources with more than 50 50 descriptions are reduced by farthest-point sampling in sentence-embedding space, with the selected prompt list fixed across methods.
This curated benchmark includes figurative and specific motifs, so its average characterizes this prompt distribution rather than material requests in general.
blocks.zh:
基准包含141个来自四个公共来源的提示:Hu等人的分类提示(2023)(30 30),MatSynth描述(Vecchio & Deschaintre,2024)(11 11),StableMatrials提示(Vecchio,2026)(50),以及文本2fabric描述(Deschaintre等人,2023)(50 50).
50个以上描述的来源在句子嵌入空间中通过最远的采样减少,选定的快速列表固定在各种方法中.
这个被整理的基准包括了虚构的和具体的动机,因此它的平均值是这种迅速分配而不是一般的物质要求的特征.

blocks.en:
We compare against three released text-to-material-map systems: MatFuse ( Vecchio et al., 2024 ) , StableMaterials ( Vecchio, 2026 ) , and IntrinsiX ( Kocsis et al., 2025 ) .
All systems produce 512 × 512 512{\times}512 maps rendered in the same Blender scenes and in both flat and staged layouts.
The layouts are useful but not representation-isolated: MatLoom ’s height drives geometric displacement, StableMaterials’ height drives bump shading, MatFuse and IntrinsiX emit no height map, and only MatLoom exposes transmission.
We therefore interpret the comparison as complete-system appearance under the recorded rendering routes (Appendix K ).
blocks.zh:
我们比较了三个发布的文本对材料图系统:MatFuse(Vecchio等人,2024年),StableMatrials (Vecchio, 2026),以及IntrinsiX(Kocsis等人,2025年).
所有系统都产生512 × 512 512 $times}512张在相同的Blender场景中以及平面和舞台布局中渲染的地图.
这些布局是有用的,但不是孤立的:MatLoom的高度驱动几何位移、StableMatrials的高度驱动冲击阴影、MatFuse和Intrinsi X不发出高度图,只有MatLoom曝光传输.
因此,我们将比较解释为在记录的渲染路线(附录K)下的完整系统外观。

blocks.en:
Prompt alignment is scored with BLIPScore ( Li et al., 2023 ) , CLIPScore ( Hessel et al., 2021 ) , VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) , and an MLLM judge ( claude-sonnet-5 , temperature zero), each scaled to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] with higher better.
These are learned visual proxies, not measures of physical accuracy or edit utility.
The six MatLoom backbones each use three recorded authoring runs per prompt with procedural-noise seeds 42 42 , 123 123 , and 2026 2026 .
Each main run uses an initial generation, 5 critique–revision rounds, trajectory selection, and up to 1000 1000 noise-seed variants for the first, selected, and last programs; this search budget is not matched to the diffusion baselines.
For paired inference we use per-prompt run means, two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, and 10,000 10{,}000 -resample percentile bootstrap confidence intervals, with Holm correction over the 24 24 flagship-versus-baseline contrasts.
Because the flagship was selected after comparing all six backbones, these tests remain exploratory.
blocks.zh:
即时对齐得分的是BLIPScore(Li等人,2023年),CLIPScore(Hessel等人,2021年),VQAScore(Lin等人,2024年),以及一名MLLM裁判(claude-sonnet-5,温度为零),每个评分都达到[0,100][0,100],成绩更好.
这些是学习到的视觉代词,而不是物理精确度或编辑效用的度量.
6台MatLoom主干线各使用3台录制的写作机,每台有程序噪声种子42 42,123 123,以及2026 2026.
每个主运行都使用初始生成,5个批判-修正回合,轨迹选择,以及最多10001000个噪音种子变体,用于第一个、选定和最后一个程序;这一搜索预算与扩散基线不匹配。

因为旗舰是在比较了所有六个骨干后被选中的,所以这些测试仍然是探索性的.

blocks.en:
The strongest configuration, gemini-3.6-flash , has the highest mean on all four alignment metrics in both layouts (Table 1 ).
Against StableMaterials in the flat layout, its mean differences are BLIPScore + 27.5 +27.5 ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 21.8 , 33.3 ] [21.8,33.3] ), CLIPScore + 3.1 +3.1 , VQAScore + 9.3 +9.3 , and judge + 9.6 +9.6 , with all four Holm-adjusted p p -values below 0.001 0.001 .
Across the three baselines, two layouts, and four metrics, 23 23 of 24 24 corrected contrasts remain significant.
The exception is the staged judge comparison with StableMaterials: + 3.0 +3.0 , 95 % 95\% CI [ − 1.2 , 7.3 ] [-1.2,7.3] , p = 0.21 p{=}0.21 .
This interval supports neither superiority nor equivalence.

blocks.en:
Backbone choice and prompt source both matter.
All six program-generating configurations exceed the strongest diffusion baseline on flat BLIPScore, but only the flagship exceeds StableMaterials on mean flat judge score; the other 5 range from 45.8 45.8 to 56.8 56.8 against 57.4 57.4 .
Per-source means also qualify the aggregate result: the flagship’s flat judge score trails StableMaterials on the StableMaterials-source and category prompts, while its overall judge advantage comes from MatSynth and text2fabric (Appendix N ).
Thus the benchmark supports competitive prompt alignment for the full program-authoring system, while leaving open whether this representation would outperform other executable material languages under matched generation and rendering conditions.

因此,该基准支持对完整的程序授权系统进行竞争性即时对齐,同时在匹配的生成和渲染条件下,该表示是否将超过其他可执行的材料语言,则留有余地.

blocks.en: 5.3 Trajectory and Proxy Behavior
blocks.zh: 5.3 轨迹和代理行为

blocks.en:
The flagship’s stored trajectory gives a within-run readout of the authoring loop (Table 2 ).
Round 0 0 already reaches 48.31 48.31 BLIPScore and 61.35 61.35 judge in the flat layout, above all three diffusion baselines on those means.
Five critique–revision rounds add + 3.5 +3.5 BLIPScore and + 6.3 +6.3 judge, while trajectory selection adds + 2.3 +2.3 BLIPScore over the last revision.
The final polished output reaches 56.06 56.06 BLIPScore, but its flat judge score is slightly below round 5 5 .
The selector beats the last revision on flat BLIPScore in 178 178 of 423 423 runs ( 42 % 42\% ), loses in 137 137 , and ties in 108 108 ; it also reduces mean flat judge by about one point.
The trajectory therefore improves some alignment proxies while revealing disagreement between the quick selection score and other judgments (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: 5.4 Program Control in One Material
blocks.zh: 5.4 一个材料的程序控制

blocks.en: Figure 5: Explicit edits to one material program. We manually change roughness, a shared grout parameter, or base-color offsets while preserving the remaining source and all three noise seeds. This is one illustrative case, not an automated-edit benchmark.
blocks.zh: 图5:明确编辑为一个材料程序. 我们手动改变粗糙度,一个共享的方块参数,或者基色抵消,同时保留剩下的源和所有三种噪声种子. 这是一个说明性案例,不是一个自动编辑基准。

blocks.en:
Figure 5 illustrates how an authored program can be edited after generation.
Starting from the final program for a two-layer tile material, we manually increase the tile roughness offset from 0.04 0.04 to 0.75 0.75 , widen grout by changing the shared mortar parameter from 0.02 0.02 to 0.06 0.06 , and shift tile base-color offsets to a blue glaze.
All other source bytes, including noise seeds and the sampling window, are preserved.
At both 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and 1024 × 1024 1024{\times}1024 , repeated evaluation in the recorded environment produces byte-identical previews; roughness and color edits change only their intended composited channels, while the grout edit deliberately propagates through channels that share the named mask (Appendix B ).
This demonstrates inspectable control for one material, not an editing success rate, an automated editor, or an advantage over alternative program representations.
blocks.zh:
图5说明了一个作者程序如何在生成后进行编辑.
从两层瓦片材料的最终程序开始,我们手动将瓦片粗糙度抵消从0.04 0.04提高到0.75 0.75,通过将共享的迫击炮参数从0.02 0.02修改为0.06 0.06,将瓦片底色抵消为蓝色格子来拓宽格子.
所有其他源字节,包括噪声种子和采样窗口,都得到保存.
在256×256\256\times}256和1024\1024\times}1024,在记录环境中的重复评价产生字节-同声预览;粗糙度和色彩编辑只改变其预定的复合频道,而grout编辑则通过共享命名面具的频道(附录B)故意传播.
这表明对某一材料的可检查控制,而不是编辑成功率、自动编辑器或相对于替代程序表示的优势。

blocks.en: 5.5 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.5 人类评价

blocks.en:
We ran a blind online preference study over 20 prompts, five from each benchmark source, drawn from the 141 141 -prompt benchmark with a seeded diversity-gated selection (Appendix J ).
Each trial showed four unlabeled 512 × 512 512{\times}512 flat-layout renders in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 grid: MatLoom with the flagship backbone and the StableMaterials, IntrinsiX, and MatFuse outputs, all at procedural seed 123 123 .
Thirty volunteers completed all trials, all passed the attention check, and none was excluded.

我们进行了20次盲目在线偏好研究,
每一次试验都显示4个未贴标签的512×512 512 {\Times}512 平板铺设在2×2 2 {\Times}2 网格: MatLoom 具有旗舰主干线和StableMatrions, IntrinsiX 和 MatFuse 输出,均在程序种子123 123 上.
30名志愿者完成了所有审判,都通过了关注检查,没有一人被排除在外。

blocks.en:
MatLoom won 59.2 % 59.2\% of the 600 600 forced choices ( 95 % 95\% CI [ 55.8 , 62.7 ] [55.8,62.7] by participant-cluster bootstrap), ahead of StableMaterials at 19.3 % 19.3\% , IntrinsiX at 15.3 % 15.3\% , and MatFuse at 6.2 % 6.2\% .
Every participant chose MatLoom more often than any one baseline across the 20 20 trials, with 8 8 – 17 17 MatLoom choices per participant.
Mean fidelity ratings were 4.98 4.98 for MatLoom , 3.60 3.60 for StableMaterials, 3.01 3.01 for IntrinsiX, and 2.27 2.27 for MatFuse.
The mean within-trial rating advantage over StableMaterials was 1.37 1.37 points on the 1 1 – 7 7 scale ( 95 % 95\% participant-cluster bootstrap CI [ 1.15 , 1.61 ] [1.15,1.61] ).
The rating advantage over StableMaterials is positive under Wilcoxon signed-rank tests both by prompt ( n = 20 n{=}20 , p = 4.4 × 10 − 4 p{=}4.4\times 10^{-4} , rank-biserial 0.83 0.83 ) and by participant mean ( n = 30 n{=}30 , p = 6.5 × 10 − 7 p{=}6.5\times 10^{-7} ).
The preference held descriptively for participants with no image-creation experience ( 60.0 % 60.0\% MatLoom win rate) and those with some experience ( 58.8 % 58.8\% ).
The study measures prompt-conditioned appearance preference on this subset, not editing utility or physical accuracy.

偏向于没有造像经验的参与者(60.0%,60.0%,MatLoom胜诉率)和有某些经验的参与者(58.8%,58.8%)。
研究衡量的是这个子集的即时条件外观偏好,而不是编辑效用或物理准确性.

blocks.en: 5.6 Limitations and Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: 5.6 对有效性的限制和威胁

blocks.en:
The fixed primitive and channel vocabulary constrains fine microstructure, specific figurative motifs, participating media, and arbitrary reflectance models.
The benchmark measures prompt alignment, not physical material accuracy, edit success, appearance consistency across resolutions, or causal value of the representation.
Holm correction covers the 24 24 flagship-versus-baseline contrasts, but it does not account for selecting the flagship from six backbones on this benchmark, so these tests remain exploratory.
The authoring pipeline uses a substantial and unmatched seed-search budget, and the diffusion baselines do not receive an equalized search or channel-routing treatment.
The staged layout combines generation with renderer differences, including displacement, bump, height availability, and transmission.
Component comparisons are exploratory because variant runs use one run per prompt (Appendix G ); they guide follow-up experiments rather than proving component necessity.
Directly testing the representation hypothesis requires controlled generation and editing comparisons against other executable material forms under matched backbones, budgets, and rendering channels.
blocks.zh:
固定的原始和通道词汇制约了精细的微观结构,特定的比喻性动机,参与媒体,以及任意的反射模型.
基准衡量的是迅速的对齐,而不是物理物质的准确性,编辑成功与否,不同决议的外观一致,或表示的因果价值.
霍尔姆校正涵盖了24个24个旗舰对基准的对比,但它并没有考虑在这个基准上从6个骨干中选择旗舰,因此这些测试仍然是探索性的.
作者的管道使用大量且没有匹配的种子搜索预算,扩散基线没有得到均衡的搜索或通道路径处理.
舞台布局结合了生成器和渲染器的差别,包括置换,凸起,高度可用,以及传输.
构件比较是探索性的,因为变体运行使用每秒一个运行(附录G);它们指导后续实验,而不是证明构件的必要性.
直接测试表示假说需要在匹配的主干线、预算和渲染渠道下对照其他可执行的材料形式进行控制生成和编辑比较。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
MatLoom studies text-to-material generation as executable authoring: compact layered programs retain the construction of each rendered asset.
On the 141 141 -prompt benchmark, its strongest configuration exceeds three diffusion baselines on all four flat-layout alignment proxies and receives 59.2 % 59.2\% of choices in a 30 30 -person blind study over 20 20 prompts.
Stored trajectories show that revision and seed search improve different proxies in different ways.
Matched generation and editing comparisons are still needed to isolate the value of this representation from backbone, budget, and renderer effects.
blocks.zh:
MatLoom作为可执行作者研究文本到材料生成:紧凑的分层程序保留了每个制成资产的构造.
在141 - 即时基准上,其最强的配置超过所有四个平放对齐代号的3个扩散基线,在30个30人盲目研究中得到59.2%的59.2\%,超过20个速率.
存储的轨迹显示,修订和种子搜索以不同的方式改进了不同的代词.
仍然需要进行匹配的生成和编辑比较,以便将这种表述的价值与骨干、预算和渲染器的效果分开。

blocks.en: AI use statement
blocks.zh: AI 语句

blocks.en:
Generative AI is part of the experimental method: hosted language models generate and critique material programs, and a separate multimodal model supplies one evaluation score.
AI tools also assisted with code development, literature search and synthesis, and manuscript drafting and editing.
The authors take responsibility for the final content, including the cited literature, mathematical statements, reported measurements, participant-study data, and released code.
blocks.zh:
Generative AI是实验方法的一部分:主机语言模型生成和批评材料程序,一个单独的多式联运模型提供一个评价分数.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work studies the generation of digital surface materials from text.
The release is limited to source code and does not redistribute benchmark prompts, baseline models, or third-party data or model weights, which remain subject to their original licenses.
An authoring system may reproduce protected surface designs or generate assets that appear plausible but have unverified physical properties, so rendered appearance should not be treated as a measured material specification.
The preference study was voluntary and began with informed consent.
Participants could optionally provide an email address for follow-up, so responses were confidential rather than anonymous.
The reported analysis excluded the email field and used de-identified responses.
blocks.zh:
这项工作研究了从文本中生成数字表面材料的问题.
发布仅限于源代码,不重新分配基准提示符,基准模型,或第三方数据或模型权重,这些仍受原始许可证的制约.
作者系统可以复制受保护的表面设计,或产生看来合理但未经核实的物理特性的资产,因此,不应将外观视为计量的材料规格。
优先研究是自愿的,在知情同意的基础上开始。
与会者可以选择提供电子邮件地址供采取后续行动,因此答复是保密的,而不是匿名的。
所报告的分析不包括电子邮件字段,并使用了去识别的答复。

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en:
The representation and compositing rules are specified in Section 3 , with an example program and grammar summary in Appendices B and C .
We will release the source code, including the engine with its parity fixture suite and the scoring pipeline.
Pinned program seeds support repeated evaluation without another language-model call, provided the engine, export settings, and rendering environment are fixed.
Cross-engine agreement is tested on a finite fixture set with explicit tolerances and exclusions (Appendix D ).
The quantitative tables and paired comparisons are computed from the stored per-run scores and the exported study responses (Appendix M ).
blocks.zh:
第3节规定了表述和编译规则,附录B和C中有一个实例程序和语法摘要。
我们将发布源代码,包括引擎及其等位固定套件和评分管道.
Pinned程序种子支持重复评价而不使用其他语言模式调用,条件是引擎,导出设置,渲染环境是固定的.
跨引擎协议在一套有明确容忍度和排除度的有限固定装置上进行测试(附录D)。
定量表格和配对比较是根据存储的每运行分数和输出的研究答复(附录M)计算的。

blocks.en: Appendix A Positioning Against Prior Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 反对先前工作的立场

blocks.en:
Table 3 separates the user input, generated representation, and execution requirements of relevant methods and standards.
Text conditioning, compact programs, material layers, and visual feedback each have precedents, so the intended comparison is the effect of MatLoom ’s restricted layer vocabulary under matched generation and editing conditions.
blocks.zh:
表3分别列出用户的投入、产生的表述以及相关方法和标准的执行要求。
文本调制,紧凑的程序,材料层和视觉反馈各有先例,因此意图的比较是MatLoom在匹配的生成和编辑条件下限制层词汇的效果.

blocks.en: Table 3: Task and representation boundaries. User conditioning is distinct from textual program encoding: MultiMat consumes compact textual programs during synthesis without evaluating natural-language-conditioned generation. Language standards are representation precedents, not learned generation systems. These properties do not imply a quality ranking, and matched generation and editing comparisons remain necessary.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 uses this same source with three manually specified edits.
Re-evaluating the four programs in the released engine reproduces all eight previews byte-for-byte, so repeated evaluation is byte-identical.
At both resolutions, the roughness and color edits change only their respective composited channels. Widening grout deliberately changes the shared mask and its affected channels.

blocks.zh:
图5使用同一来源,有3个手动指定的编辑.
重新评价发布引擎中的四个程序复制了所有八个字节的预览,所以重复的评价是字节相同的.

blocks.en: Appendix C Grammar Summary
blocks.zh: 附录C 语法 目 录

blocks.en:
Listing 2 summarizes canonical program syntax in EBNF, with keyword-argument and lexical productions condensed for space.
The full specification is included in the implementation’s README, while the generator uses an operational language reference and the engine’s parser.
The regression suite validates the serialization of 30 30 generated examples against the full grammar and tests selected malformed expressions.
This finite test suite does not prove that every parser-accepted program is admitted by the canonical grammar or produces numerically valid fields.
Reference resolution and constructor constraints are checked while parsing, and channel values are clamped during evaluation (Section 3.4 ).
blocks.zh:
Listing 2总结了EBNF中的canonical程序语法,其中关键词参数和词典制作为空间缩合.
完整的规格包含在执行的README中,而生成器使用操作语言参考和引擎的解析器.
回归套件验证了30个生成的例子的序列化,对照完整的语法,并测试了选定的畸形表达式.
这个有限的测试套件并不能证明每个parser-accessed程序都被cononic语法所接受或者产生数字有效的字段.
在解析时检查参考解析度和构造器的制约,并在评价时限制通道值(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: Listing 2: Condensed EBNF summary of the layered-material representation, with start symbol program . This listing omits lexical definitions and is not a standalone recognizer specification. The released source contains the full canonical grammar and its regression tests.

blocks.en: Appendix D Cross-engine Parity
blocks.zh: 附录D 均等

blocks.en:
The Python reference generates expected values for a shared fixture suite, and the TypeScript port is compared against those values.
The suite distinguishes exact comparisons, numerical tolerances, and excluded cases rather than asserting universal cross-engine identity.
blocks.zh:
Python 引用生成共享固定套件的预期值,TypeScript端口则与这些值进行比较.
该套套装区分了准确的比较,数字的容忍度,以及排除的情况,而不是坚持通用的跨引擎身份.

blocks.en:
Selected arithmetic operations, leaves, thresholding, hard-edged brick and weave patterns, separable transforms, shape fill decisions, canonical serialization, and packed surface-channel bytes use exact comparisons.
Hard-boundary samples are chosen away from shape edges, where coordinate precision can change a fill decision.
These checks establish agreement on the sampled cases.
blocks.zh:
选用算术操作,叶片,阈值,硬底砖和编织图案,可分离变形,形状填充决定,犬形串联,包装的表道字节使用精确比较.
硬边标本从形状边缘选择,其中坐标精度可以改变填充决定.
这些检查就抽样案件达成了协议。

blocks.en:
Scalar expressions involving transcendental functions and multi-octave noise use a tolerance of approximately 10 − 11 10^{-11} .
Feathered shapes, weave coverage, gridded fBm , and relief use tolerances of approximately 10 − 6 10^{-6} to 10 − 5 10^{-5} to accommodate float32 storage and evaluation differences.
The thresholds are test tolerances, not error bounds proved for arbitrary programs.
blocks.zh:
涉及超自然功能和多视噪声的Scalar表达法使用约10−11 10^{-11}的耐受度.
Feathered facts, 编织覆盖, 网格化的fBm, 以及救济使用大约10−6 10−6}到 10− 5 10−5}的耐力, 以适应浮点32的存储和评价差异.
阈值是测试耐受性,而不是为任意程序证明的错误界限.

blocks.en:
Worley uses a 64-bit hash in Python and a 32-bit hash in TypeScript, so identical seeds do not imply identical fields for this primitive.
The browser’s WebGPU preview is outside the cross-engine comparison, while CPU worker backends have separate within-TypeScript parity tests.
Browser channel packing quantizes IOR over [ 1 , 3 ] [1,3] , whereas the Python engine supports IOR values above 3 3 in its floating-point export.
The Python HDR fallback clips negative height values, which require EXR to preserve.
These differences limit claims of interchangeable numerical output.
blocks.zh:
Worley在Python中使用64位散列,在TypeScript中则使用32位散列,因此,对于这种原始体来说,相同的种子并不意味着相同的球场.
浏览器的WebGPU预览在跨引擎比较之外,而CPU工人后端则有独立的TypeScript内部对等测试.
浏览器通道包装将IOR在 [1, 3] [1, 3] 上量化, 而 Python 引擎在浮动点导出时支持IOR值高于 3 。
Python HDR回落剪辑负高值,需要EXR保存.
这些差异限制了对可互换数字输出的主张.

blocks.en:
The viewer loads supported programs and exposes source editing and lighting controls without a DCC application.
It provides an execution and inspection interface, rather than evidence that final images match Blender under different shading and lighting.
The released source pins the engine revision and includes the fixture suite with its tolerances.
blocks.zh:
查看器加载支持了程序,并暴露了没有DCC应用程序的源编辑和照明控制.
它提供了一个执行和检查接口,而不是证明最终图像在不同阴影和照明下与Blender匹配。
发布源将引擎修正钉上,并包含带有其耐受性的固定套件.

blocks.en: Appendix E Refinement Depth, Selection, and Polish
blocks.zh: 附录E 完善深度、选择和波兰语

blocks.en: Appendix F Runtime Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 运行时间分析

blocks.en:
Table 8 reports recorded wall-clock times for the complete authoring runs, with every stage running sequentially in one process per prompt.
For the flagship, the median run takes 4.6 4.6 minutes: 40 40 seconds for the six generation calls, 42 42 seconds for the six critique calls (one per trajectory program, the last triggering no revision), 1.7 1.7 seconds for trajectory selection, and 181 181 seconds for seed search over 2 or 3 candidates, with the remainder spent on lazy scorer loading and program canonicalization.
The initial proposal has a median latency of 11 11 seconds, and each revision or critique call takes 5 to 7 seconds.
Each seed sweep renders 1001 1001 candidates at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 and scores them in a median of 70 70 seconds, about 70 70 milliseconds per candidate, covering a preview evaluation and one text–image scorer encode.
Critique and trajectory-selection renders use 512 × 512 512{\times}512 previews, and channel statistics are computed on a 128 × 128 128{\times}128 grid.
The seed search is roughly constant across backbones, so end-to-end differences reflect the language-model calls, whose combined medians reach 910 910 seconds for the slowest backbone.
The recorded hardware and scorer-device specifications are unavailable, so these wall-clock figures should not be used as cross-system latency comparisons.

blocks.en: Appendix I Exploratory Parameter Search

blocks.en:
An exploratory variant searches continuous numeric literals selected by the engine using CMA-ES ( Hansen, 2016 ) , with frequencies in log space, bounded channel weights, and the base layer’s alpha and view window excluded.
The recorded configuration uses σ 0 = 0.25 \sigma_{0}=0.25 and a budget of 500 500 evaluations per candidate against the quick scorer.
Figure 6 shows results from 3 separate runs for “a red brick wall” whose visual ordering differs from their quick-score improvements.
The panels are different outputs ordered by the authors’ visual assessment, not successive steps of one optimization trajectory.
This is qualitative evidence of proxy mismatch, not a controlled estimate of how often parameter search fails.
Stored sweeps for the same prompt quantify the asymmetry: at a matched budget of 500 500 evaluations, parameter search improved the quick scorer by a mean of + 1.6 +1.6 points, against + 0.2 +0.2 for seed-only search, and 3 of 13 parameter-search candidates failed to improve their start point.

所记录的配置使用xx0=0.25\sigma\0\0.25,预算每名候选人对快速计分员进行500次评价.

这些小组是作者的视觉评估所命令的不同产出,而不是一个优化轨迹的连续步骤。
这是代理错配的定性证据,而不是对参数搜索失败次数的控制估计.
存储扫描同样快速量化不对称:在500个评价的对应预算上,参数搜索改进了快速计分器,平均值为+1.6+1.6分,而只种子搜索为+0.2+0.2,13个参数搜索考生中有3个未能改善起始点.

blocks.en:
Seed search preserves all non-seed source within each candidate, including explicit lattice parameters, but noise can still affect masks, color, and height enough to reduce visual fidelity.
Accepting a candidate only when its quick score improves protects that score, not appearance or external evaluation metrics.
The choice of seed-only search is therefore a restriction of the search space rather than a guarantee against degradation.
Independent judgments of the stored before-and-after programs are unavailable, so this comparison does not establish which search space gives better perceived materials.

只有在候选人的快速得分提高后,才接受该候选人,而不是外表或外部评价衡量标准。
因此,只选择种子搜索是对搜索空间的限制,而不是防止退化的保证.
无法对存储的前后程序进行独立判断,因此这一比较无法确定哪个搜索空间能提供更好的感知材料.

blocks.en: Appendix J User Study Protocol and Results
blocks.zh: 附录J 用户研究协议和结果

blocks.en:
We ran a blind online preference study, delivered through Qualtrics in English and Chinese.
Twenty prompts, five from each benchmark source, were drawn from the 141 141 -prompt benchmark with a seeded random selection subject to a Jaccard-similarity diversity guard, and the selection was frozen before recruitment.
The stimuli reused the seed- 123 123 flat-layout evaluation outputs of the flagship and the three baselines: 80 512 × 512 512{\times}512 renders, each recorded in a trial manifest with its checksum. MatLoom occupied each display position in exactly five of the 20 items, the remaining methods filled the other positions at random, and the layout was fixed per prompt rather than redrawn per participant.
The session opened with informed consent and a background block recording image-creation experience and self-reported normal color vision.
Trial order was randomized per participant in two 10-trial blocks, with an instructed attention check between them.
Each trial showed the four unlabeled renders in a 2 × 2 2{\times}2 grid and recorded which image best matched the prompt together with a 1 1 – 7 7 prompt-fidelity rating for every image.
Participation was voluntary and began with an informed-consent screen.
The questionnaire did not request names, but participants could optionally provide an email address for follow-up, so responses were confidential rather than anonymous.
The reported analysis excluded the email field and used de-identified responses.

Thirty participants completed the study, all passed the attention check, and none was excluded, leaving 600 600 paired decisions with no straight-line response patterns.
Table 11 reports the outcomes. MatLoom won 59.2 % 59.2\% of forced choices with a mean rating of 4.98 4.98 , StableMaterials followed at 19.3 % 19.3\% and 3.60 3.60 , IntrinsiX at 15.3 % 15.3\% and 3.01 3.01 , and MatFuse at 6.2 % 6.2\% and 2.27 2.27 .
The rating advantage over StableMaterials was positive at both test levels ( p = 4.4 × 10 − 4 p{=}4.4\times 10^{-4} prompt-level, p = 6.5 × 10 − 7 p{=}6.5\times 10^{-7} participant-mean), and MatLoom was the forced choice on every one of the 20 prompts by at least 4 of the 30 participants.
Ten participants ( 33 % 33\% ) reported no image-creation experience and 20 ( 67 % 67\% ) reported some, and MatLoom ’s win rate was 60.0 % 60.0\% in the inexperienced group against StableMaterials’ 21.5 % 21.5\% , and 58.8 % 58.8\% in the experienced group against 18.2 % 18.2\% .
Median per-trial completion time was 36.5 36.5 seconds, and participants gave free-text reasons on 192 192 of the 600 600 trials.

blocks.en: Q.4 Serialization Controls
blocks.zh: 问题4. 序列控制

blocks.en:
An inlined serialization removes named definitions by replacing every use with a copy of its resolved expression while keeping explicit noise seeds verbatim.
Of the 2538 2538 stored initial programs, 2514 2514 ( 99 % 99\% ) use named definitions, inlining raises source length by a median factor of 1.4 1.4 , and the inlined form re-parses and exports channel maps byte-identical to the named-field form for every one of these programs.
This equivalence lets future generation and editing comparisons vary explicit reuse and serialization length while holding evaluation semantics fixed.

内嵌式序列化通过将每种用途替换为其解析表达式的副本,同时保持清晰的噪声种子逐字删除命名定义.
在2538 2538 存储的初始程序中,2514 2514(99 % 99\%)使用命名定义,内衬将源长提高中位系数1.4 1.4,内衬形式重新分解并导出每个这些程序的频道地图与命名域表格的字节一致.
这种等效性使得后世和编辑比较在保持评价语义固定的同时,会有明显的重复使用和序列长度的不同.

blocks.en:
An explicit-channel form without layer grouping has no established equivalent yet.
Expanding the layer stack faithfully must preserve the zero-coverage branch, color-space conversion, and separate maximum-height rule, and a generic weighted sum would change the target semantics.
Direct Blender, native graph, or other material-generation systems provide complementary end-to-end comparisons, but changing their library and execution interface does not isolate the effect of named fields or layers.

层叠的扩展必须忠实地保留零覆盖分支,色彩空间转换,以及独立的最大高度规则,一个通用加权和会改变目标语义.

blocks.en:
The seed-variant mechanism replaces repeated occurrences of the same numeric seed together, preserving equality groups and all non-seed source within each candidate structure.
This is a source-level constraint.
Attribute preservation and perceptual diversity still require measurement, especially when a seeded field drives coverage or relief.

blocks.en: Q.7 Prompt, Critic, and Renderer Mechanics
blocks.zh: 问题7. 迅速、批评和渲染力学

blocks.en:
The generator receives an operational DSL reference describing structure, channel ranges, expressions, and compositing semantics.
Six few-shot examples span one to four layers, and an organic-texture playbook supplies idioms such as combining low- and high-frequency fBm fields (Appendix O ).
The language reference is supplied as context, without constraining the model’s token-level decoding.
blocks.zh:
生成器收到一个可操作的DSL参考,描述结构,通道范围,表达式,以及混杂的语义.

语言引用作为上下文提供,不限制模型的符号级解码.

blocks.en:
The quick render evaluates the composited maps and height-derived normals, then shades a head-on swatch under a fixed directional light.
It uses approximate Blinn-Phong specular shading, Fresnel, sheen, subsurface, and transmission terms rather than path tracing.
It does not reproduce global illumination or physical refraction, so feedback can miss effects that become visible in a staged render.
The material statistics contain 28 28 descriptors of the unlit channel maps, covering albedo, texture, roughness, metallicity, height, normal tilt, occlusion, and other channel summaries.
Each statistic is paired with a short definition.
blocks.zh:
快速渲染能评价复合图和高度衍生的常态,然后在固定的方向灯下遮蔽一个头部的表.
它使用大约Blinn-Phong的光谱阴影、Fresnel、 Sheen、地下和传输术语,而不是路径跟踪。
它不复制全球照明或物理折射,因此反馈可能会错过在舞台渲染中可见的效果.
材料统计中包含28个未读通道图的描述符,涵盖反照率,纹理,粗糙度,金属度,高度,正常倾斜度,隐蔽度,以及其他通道摘要.
每个统计都有一个简短的定义。

blocks.en: R.1 Protocol Details
blocks.zh: R.1 议定书细节

blocks.en:
The representation targets surface appearance through spatial patterns, layers, and material channels.
We retain prompts with figurative or highly specific motifs to test where this representation becomes restrictive.
Every prompt is evaluated with both rendering layouts, and every scored run is retained in the quantitative tables.
The text-only backbones, DeepSeek and GLM, receive code and statistics without the quick render during critique.
The retained run tree contains 423 423 complete conversations per backbone and no aborted attempts; per-turn repair counts are not logged, so first-pass validity within a turn is not measured.
The flagship’s recorded median authoring time is 4.6 4.6 minutes, with a median 68 % 68\% of time spent in polishing, the Stage III seed search (Appendix F ).
Compact output size therefore should not be read as cheap authoring.

blocks.en: R.3 Proxy Mismatch Example
blocks.zh: R.3 代理错配示例

blocks.en:
An exploratory parameter-search variant (Appendix I ) provides a qualitative diagnostic for proxy mismatch.
Three separate runs for “a red brick wall” produce regular brick rows, a wall with broad breaks and irregular cracks, and a wavy texture without recognizable brick rows.
The authors’ visual ordering differs from the recorded quick-score gains of + 2.0 +2.0 , + 3.7 +3.7 , and + 0.7 +0.7 points, with the largest quick-score increase assigned to the middle example.
This motivates inspecting structural changes alongside proxy scores, but it does not establish a general failure rate for parameter search or guarantee that seed-only search preserves appearance.
blocks.zh:
探索性参数-搜索变体(Appendix I)为代理不匹配提供了定性诊断.
用于“红砖墙”的三道独立跑道产生固定的砖排、宽阔断裂和不规则裂缝的墙壁和没有可辨认的砖排的瓦质纹理。
作者的视觉订单不同于记录的快速分数增益+2.0+2.0,+3.7+3.7,+0.7+0.7的分数,其中快速分数增益最大的是中例.
这激励了在代理分数的同时检查结构变化,但它并没有为参数搜索确立一个一般的失败率,也没有保证只有种子搜索才能保存外观.
